outcomes.question: What time is the cut-off for same-day dispatch?
outcomes.answer: The cut-off for same-day dispatch is before 2 pm UK time, Monday to Friday [shipping-and-delivery].

outcomes.question: How much does standard UK delivery cost?
outcomes.answer: Standard UK delivery costs £4.95, but it is free on retail orders of £50 or more [shipping-and-delivery]. Deliveries to the Scottish Highlands, the islands, and Northern Ireland carry a surcharge of £3.00 per order [shipping-and-delivery].

outcomes.question: How long do I have to return an item for a refund?
outcomes.answer: You can return unused items in their original packaging for a refund within 30 days of delivery [returns-and-refunds]. If you have a wholesale order, returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery and only for faulty goods or goods sent in error [wholesale-terms].

outcomes.question: Which items cannot be returned?
outcomes.answer: Unless they are faulty, the items that cannot be returned are personalised or engraved items, candles that have been lit, perishable food and drink, and gift vouchers [returns-and-refunds].

outcomes.question: What is the minimum first order for a wholesale account?
outcomes.answer: The minimum first order for a wholesale account is £250 [wholesale-terms].

outcomes.question: When can a wholesale account pay on invoice terms?
outcomes.answer: A wholesale account can move to invoice terms of 30 days after 3 successful orders, with an initial credit limit of £2,000 [wholesale-terms].

outcomes.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
outcomes.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay, and wholesale customers can also pay by bank transfer [payment-and-invoicing]. Payment is accepted in pounds sterling only [payment-and-invoicing].

outcomes.question: Do wholesale prices include VAT?
outcomes.answer: No, wholesale prices are shown excluding VAT, and VAT is added at checkout [wholesale-terms].

outcomes.question: How long should I burn a candle at a time?
outcomes.answer: You should burn candles for no more than 3 to 4 hours at a time [product-care-and-safety].

outcomes.question: Can I put the ceramic mugs in the dishwasher?
outcomes.answer: Hand washing is recommended for all ceramics [product-care-and-safety]. They are dishwasher safe only when the product page or base marking says so [product-care-and-safety].

outcomes.question: How soon must I report a damaged delivery?
outcomes.answer: If an item arrives damaged, you must tell us within 48 hours of delivery [damaged-or-missing-items]. Breakages in wholesale cartons must also be reported within 48 hours of delivery [damaged-or-missing-items].

outcomes.question: My parcel says delivered but I never received it. What should I do?
outcomes.answer: If tracking shows your parcel as delivered but you have not received it, you must contact us within 5 working days [damaged-or-missing-items]. We will investigate with the courier, which can take up to 10 working days, and send a replacement or refund once the investigation is complete [damaged-or-missing-items].

outcomes.question: How long do you keep my order records?
outcomes.answer: Order records are kept for 6 years because tax law requires it [customer-account-and-privacy].

outcomes.question: How long is a password reset link valid?
outcomes.answer: A password reset link is valid for 1 hour [customer-account-and-privacy].

outcomes.question: Who pays customs duties on an order to Australia?
outcomes.answer: The customer is responsible for any import duties, taxes and customs fees charged by the destination country for deliveries outside the UK, which includes Australia [international-orders-and-customs].

outcomes.question: What is the last UK standard delivery order date for Christmas?
outcomes.answer: To arrive before Christmas, retail customers must order by 15 December for UK standard delivery [seasonal-ordering-and-christmas-deadlines].

outcomes.question: Which month is the busiest for orders?
outcomes.answer: November is the busiest month [seasonal-ordering-and-christmas-deadlines].

outcomes.question: Is there a physical shop I can visit?
outcomes.answer: No, Cottage Lane Gifts is an online-only retailer and has no physical shop [faq-general].

outcomes.question: How much is gift wrapping?
outcomes.answer: Gift wrapping costs £2.50 per item [faq-general].

outcomes.question: How long are gift vouchers valid?
outcomes.answer: Gift vouchers are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase [faq-general].

outcomes.question: I bought a mug on 20 November. Until when can I return it?
outcomes.answer: Retail items bought between 1 November and 24 December can be returned until 31 January, instead of the usual 30 days [seasonal-ordering-and-christmas-deadlines]. However, this extended window does not apply to wholesale orders [seasonal-ordering-and-christmas-deadlines].

outcomes.question: We are a shop and want to return an unwanted wholesale carton after three weeks. Is that possible?
outcomes.answer: No, that is not possible. Wholesale returns are only accepted within 14 days of delivery and only for faulty goods or goods sent in error [wholesale-terms]. Additionally, change-of-mind returns are not accepted on wholesale orders [wholesale-terms].

outcomes.question: What discount does a wholesale customer get on a £1,200 order?
outcomes.answer: Orders of £1,000 or more receive 40% off retail prices [wholesale-terms]. Therefore, a customer gets a 40% discount on a £1,200 order [wholesale-terms].
